title: RERR messages can be spoofed to trigger route deletions
description: Lines 439-457: RERR accepts any error_code/address with optional signature. Attacker can forge REERs to delete routes. Fix: document signature requirement, validate error_code.
close_reason: Fixed: Added RerrCode enum with valid codes (RouteNotFound=0, LinkFailure=1), validation in from_bytes rejects unknown codes, updated SECURITY comment to clarify signature requirements, added tests for error code validation
